prompts.maskedBattle: Use case: style-transfer. Create ONE masked warrior monk battle sprite matching the exact game sprite style of image1 Masanori and image2 the newly reworked unmasked monk. Image3 old masked monk is IDENTITY/COSTUME ONLY; replace its painterly texture and realistic proportions. Same artist and same simple angular flat shading as image2, same pixel density and expressive large-head anime proportions as image1. Pale ivory layered wide-sleeve robes, charcoal underlayers/gloves, red-brown waist armor panels simplified into broad bands with sparse lacing, dark shin wraps, sandals. Ivory hood covers head and a cloth scarf covers nose/mouth/neck, leaving only a large clear eye slit with strong brows; no exposed mouth, no hair, no metal mask. Use a larger head and hood with compact torso, broad readable silhouette; match image2 body scale and costume. One complete naginata held in both hands, continuous dark shaft and curved steel blade, upright diagonal guard beside face, no clipping of blade or butt. Nearly frontal ready stance, slightly toward lower-left. Design body height236px on final 288x384 canvas, extra height for weapon only. Flat clean cloth color blocks with 2-3 sharp shadow values, restrained charcoal outlines. NO fine cloth texture, noise, dithering, painterly gradients, realistic skin wrinkles, tiny repeated folds or saturated fringe. Upper-left light, genuine transparency, no background, ground shadow, text, border or extra figures/poses.
prompts.maskedWalking:
Use case: style-transfer. Make ONE transparent RPG Maker MZ overworld walking sheet. Images1 and2 (current Masanori and Shinsengumi walking sheets) are the EXACT rendering/proportion templates: recreate their same artist, chunky pixel density, very large expressive head, short compact torso and short legs. Image3 (reworked monk battle art) supplies clothing and identity only, not body proportions. A walking figure must be about THREE to THREE-AND-A-HALF heads tall, NOT a shrunken realistic battle illustration. At final 67px crown-to-sole body height the HEAD must be about20-22px tall, torso about20px, lower body about25px. Broad readable sleeves/hands/sandals matching Masanori's native sprite shapes. Simplified ivory robes in a few flat color blocks with sharp angular shadows, charcoal underlayers/gloves, red-brown waist armor as a few broad bands, dark shin wraps, straw sandals; no microscopic cloth texture or fine armor dots. ONE carried naginata upright beside body; complete curved blade, continuous shaft and butt visible in every pose, fixed weapon length, coherent hand grip.
EXACT sheet layout 3 columns by4 rows, twelve complete figures in separated transparent cells. Rows strictly down/front, left, right, up/back. Columns walkA / neutral feet-together standing / walkB. ColumnA andB must be truly opposite steps: left leg leads A, right leg leads B, lead sandal swaps left-right in front/back views and different legs lead in profiles, no duplicate forward-foot poses. Preserve character anatomy, costume and head size across all12frames. Feet same baseline withinrow, no drifting and only slight bob. Equal generous gaps, no touching cells. Final export target64x112 cells, feet centered nearx32 at sole y108. Body67px matches current Masanori; taller canvas only for full polearm and transparent margins. Match source1/source2 face size, compact body and broad pixel clusters precisely. Upper-left lighting, charcoal crisp outlines, no saturated red/green outlines, no grain, no painterly shading, no smooth gradients, no labels/grid/background/shadows. Genuine alpha transparency. Subject MASKED monk: ivory hood over head and scarf around nose/mouth/neck, broad readable eye slit with strong eyes and eyebrows; no visible hair or mouth. Image4 old masked battle art is only to specify the hood and wrap, not its rendering.
